events.context: Discussion of AI alignment theory, Type C systems, Theorem 3 on infeasibility due to hidden constraints
AI proposes reorganisation of original paper into 8 sections with Alignment Feasibility Theorem as core
AI addresses technical challenges: strategy space measure, constraint independence, hiddenness modeling
AI suggests 5-step plan for minimal provable version targeting NeurIPS/ICML Theory Track
AI evaluates new paper version with 6 theorems (1-6), praises theoretical depth, suggests Master Theorem
AI recommends NeurIPS 2025 Theory Track, rates paper 8.5/10 with NeurIPS oral potential
User asks 'rm -rf的照片如何找回' - how to recover photos deleted by rm -rf command

AI provides Linux recovery guide: extundelete install `sudo apt-get install extundelete`, umount `sudo umount /dev/sda1`, restore `sudo extundelete /dev/sda1 --restore-all`; TestDisk/PhotoRec `sudo apt-get install testdisk`, `sudo photorec /dev/sda1`
AI provides macOS recovery: check Time Machine/iCloud backups; Disk Drill/EaseUS software; TestDisk `brew install testdisk`, `photorec`
User asks 'photorec在哪个目录实施' - where to run photorec
AI instructs to run PhotoRec from external drive: `cd /Volumes/你的外置硬盘名/photorec文件夹路径`, `sudo ./photorec`, save to external drive
User runs PhotoRec, shows interface: Disk /dev/disk4 - 8053 MB (RO), Disk /dev/rdisk1 - 524 MB (RO), Disk /dev/rdisk4 - 8053 MB (RO)
AI interprets PhotoRec disk selection interface, instructs to select Mac internal disk, asks for next interface details
User runs `sudo ./photorec` from ostensible_paradox@mothership biaze8GB, gets 'sudo: ./photorec: command not found'
AI diagnoses command not found error, instructs `ls -la` to check directory contents for correct photorec filename
